card.name: Words leading into incidence and rate statistics
card.fires_on: Small linking words and nouns just before a number, rate, incidence or prevalence figure is reported, such as 'ranged from', 'screening was', or 'states had obesity'. It appears in clinical trial and public health statistics text.

modes.label: Before a count or range
modes.description: A linking word right before a total, range or number in a statistics sentence.
modes.example: 119countries reported<< a>> total of 95 million people tested

modes.label: Trial conditions before incidence
modes.description: Words in a clause describing the trial group, just before an incidence figure.
modes.example: patients in 9 clinical trials with abacavir-containing products where HLA-B*5701 screening<< was>> not performed.

modes.label: Obesity rate phrases
modes.description: The word obesity or a population word just before a rate or prevalence figure.
modes.example: by 2030, 13 states could have<< obesity>> rates over 60-percent.

card.writes: It seems to prepare words about averages, rates and widespread occurrence, but the effect is weak and mixed.
card.plain: It fires on the little words that come right before a rate, total or incidence number is given.
